area: Bromley-by-Bow / Poplar west of Bow Creek: Teviot, Spey, Brunswick, Lochnagar, Ailsa and Leven streets; St Leonard's and Ailsa Wharves (oil works) on Bow Creek
method: sheet; sweep 9 crops at 2x with anchors recorded at opening (r0c0 SPEY STREET/BRUNSWICK, r0c1 St. Leona../Mud, r0c2 St. Leonard's Wharf (Oil Works), r1c0 ..ETLAND STREET/Sun. Sch., r1c1 Poplar & Bromley Tabernacle/LOCHNAGAR, r1c2 AILSA STREET/Ailsa Wharf, r2c0 Phoenix Saw Mills/ULLIN STREET, r2c1 BROMLEY HALL ROAD/School, r2c2 LEVEN ROAD/School Boys, Girls & Infants); 6x position sheets csA-csD, 12x bench-mark sheet csE, 8x digit sheets csF, csG, csI, 6x csH and 10x nearest csHnn for 6/8, 10x csJ; region views regSE (3x) and regNE (4x); numeric dot centroids; marker sheet. All crops and sheets displayed when opened.
legibility: clear; dense terrace lettering with interpuncts (C·K in BRUNSWICK, R·E in STREET, possibly HALL). sheet tool reports no join; a perfectly straight vertical line at px ~826 runs the full height through houses (possible join, no tint step seen) and a faint horizontal tint step at py ~961 in the SE open ground
